row.evidence: Insightly's help centre says "SAML and SCIM are only available on the Enterprise level plan", and its CRM plan limits table marks SAML and SCIM single sign-on as not available on Plus or Professional.
row.notes: CRM pricing: Plus $29, Professional $49, Enterprise $99 per user/mo, USD billed annually. SAML and SCIM both start at Enterprise; SCIM requires SAML to be enabled first, and SAML is IdP-initiated only. SCIM 2.0 supports /Users and /Schemas only (no Groups, no Bulk); DELETE deactivates (active=false), no hard delete; product licences are not assigned by SCIM and must be added by an admin afterwards. Okta (OIN, SCIM create/update/deactivate) and Entra (Insightly SAML gallery app with provisioning) have catalogue apps; OneLogin uses a SAML Custom Connector (SSO only). The REST API v3.1 is on all plans (Basic auth with a per-user API key) but its Users endpoints are read-only.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: $99 per user / month, billed annually (Contact sales)
plans.notes: Comprehensive audit logging (18-month retention) on Enterprise; no audit-log API found.

auth.token_source: System Settings > Security > SAML and SCIM: check Enable SCIM Provisioning and Save to generate the SCIM Token and SCIM URL
auth.notes: Regenerate invalidates previous tokens. Okta takes the token in its API Token field; the header scheme is not stated.

operations.notes: PATCH supports only the replace operation. active is editable, so reactivation via active=true is plausible but not stated.

attributes.notes: userName maps to the user's email; emails is read-only with a single type=work address.

roles.how: Not via SCIM; product licences are assigned manually by an admin after provisioning.

limitations.text: SCIM requires SAML to be enabled and set up first; SAML is IdP-initiated only (no SP-initiated).
Only /Users and /Schemas; batch operations are not supported.
Product licences are not assigned by SCIM; an admin must assign them per user afterwards.
No hard delete: DELETE /Users/{id} sets active=false.
Filtering supports only userName eq; PATCH supports only replace.
SAML and SCIM are not supported on the Insightly mobile application.

auth.notes: Per-user API key as the Basic-auth username; calls run with that user's permissions. Admins can turn API access off per user.

capabilities.notes: The v3.1 swagger lists only GET operations on /Users (list, get, Me, Search). Teams (user groups) can be created, updated, deleted and have members added or removed.

endpoints.purpose: Gets the User object for the calling user
Gets a filtered list of Users
Gets the Permissions for a User

audit_log_api.notes: Enterprise has comprehensive audit logging in-app; no audit-log endpoint appears in the v3.1 swagger.

rate_limits.text: No more than 10 requests per second per instance; daily limit by plan: Plus 40,000, Professional 60,000, Enterprise 100,000 requests/day/instance; 429 when reached.

limitations.text: Users endpoints are read-only: users cannot be created, updated or deactivated through the REST API.

okta.notes: OIN capability list (rendered DOM) marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate checked; Group Push unchecked. Okta's page does not name the builder.

entra.notes: Gallery app is named 'Insightly SAML'. Entra maps userName, active, name.givenName and name.familyName.

onelogin.notes: Insightly's OneLogin guide uses the generic SAML Custom Connector (Advanced); no SCIM setup is described.

fallbacks.notes: For SAML without SCIM, the guide says to add users to Insightly first and have them complete registration, which suggests no JIT, but it does not say so outright.

open_questions: SCIM base URL pattern and auth header scheme are not published (the URL and token are revealed in-app).
Docs do not say whether SCIM deactivation frees the paid licence or ends active sessions.
Reactivation via SCIM (active=true) is not explicitly documented.
Whether Insightly supports SAML JIT user creation is not stated.
No Google Workspace or JumpCloud catalogue app with SAML or provisioning was confirmed.
